whatYouGet.question: What exactly do I get when I buy a prompt?
whatYouGet.answer: A plain Markdown (.md) file. Drop it into your repo as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, a Cursor rule or a custom command. There is no app to install and no account needed to use it.

previewFirst.question: Can I read a prompt before buying it?
previewFirst.answer: Yes. Every listing has a free preview of the first lines of the file, so you can judge its structure and tone before paying.

supportedTools.question: Which AI coding tools do the prompts work with?
supportedTools.answer: Any tool that reads Markdown instructions: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Aider and others. Each listing shows the tools its author tested it with.

updates.question: Do I get updates when the author improves the file?
updates.answer: Yes. Purchases include every future version of the file, and you can compare versions before replacing the copy in your repo.

sellerPayouts.question: How do sellers get paid?
sellerPayouts.answer: Sellers set their own price and are paid for every sale. Write to the seller team to request access while seller onboarding is in early access.
